en.t: He hurriedly scrambled to his feet.

units.source_text: 脸上、头上、胸口上堆满了沙子，唰唰地掉落下来。

en.t: Sand had piled up on his face, head, and chest, and came sliding down with a soft rustle.

units.source_text: 汗凝结的沙子，牢牢地粘在嘴唇、鼻子周围。

en.t: The sand clotted with sweat clung tightly around his lips and nose.

units.source_text: 他一边用手背蹭掉沙子，一边提心吊胆地不停眨着眼睛。

en.t: As he rubbed the sand away with the back of his hand, he kept blinking nervously.

units.source_text: 热得火烧火燎，粗糙的眼皮下，没完没了地流着泪。

en.t: It burned with heat, and tears flowed endlessly beneath his roughened eyelids.

units.source_text: 可光靠眼泪来冲洗涂抹着眼屎的沙子，显然是不够的。

en.t: But tears alone were clearly not enough to wash away the sand smeared with eye discharge.
